What is a Document Portal?

A document portal is a centralized hub where you can store, manage, and share documents with others. It's a secure and organized way to keep track of important papers, such as contracts, invoices, and work orders. With a document portal, you can easily search, access, and share documents, reducing the time and hassle of manual paperwork.
